column4: 村に到着した・・が、すでに
column5: We arrived at the village... but already,

column4: ルメイ特別焼却師団が包囲して、村人を逃げられないようにして
column5: The LeMay special incineration corps has surrounded it, preventing the villagers from escaping.

column4: 周囲に火を付けていた所だった。
column5: They were just about to set fire all around.

column4: 軍人同士が殺し合うのは分かる
column5: I understand soldiers fighting each other to the death.

column4: 民間人が不運にも巻き込まれるのも分かる
column5: I understand civilians getting caught up in it by misfortune.

column4: だが、奴らは最初から民間人を殺す為だけに行動している
column5: But those guys act solely to kill civilians from the start.

column4: ちょい待て、敵が多すぎる、それにこちらが来るのを分かって
column5: Wait a moment, there are too many enemies, plus they knew we were coming.

column4: 待ち構えているぞ・・でも謙信は止まらず突っ込む
column5: They're lying in wait... but Kenshin doesn't stop and charges in.

column4: しかたなくランス達も戦闘に参加
column5: Reluctantly, Rance and the others join the fight.

column4: （ランスと謙信は別部隊として戦っています　乱戦）
column5: (Rance and Kenshin are fighting as separate units in the melee.)
